order: Rotate engine order by trial, seed and batch. Fresh serial workers. One scheduler bound core; no concurrent build or testing.
scope: Existing saved ETT correction models and 32 validation windows only. Linux portability and legacy runtime compatibility; no current-runtime frontier, cross-host software advantage, retraining, alpha or production claim.
memory: Owned buffers separately from process RSS
failures: Retain all failures and original failed outputs. No weakening numerical gates or favourable reruns.
